content.text: Done scrolling through all 15 screens. I'm going with Harel's S&P 500 track and writing it up now.

input.answer: I'd go with Harel's "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track (fund 13414): it's the S&P that everyone talks about, Harel is a name I know, the fee is 0.56% and it shows 13.7% for 3 years and 11.92% for 5 years. I'm fairly sure, but there were so many look-alike rows that I mostly stuck with the first decent one I saw.

stuck.where: Second screen onwards, the long table
stuck.why: Way too many rows (143 tracks), and they all look nearly the same: fees from 0.5% to 0.7%, S&P ones around 13%. After about four screens I wasn't comparing anymore, just scrolling. I'd honestly have closed it by screen 6–7 if I didn't already have a pick.

stuck.where: Filter chips at the top ("עוקב מדד S&P 500 12")
stuck.why: That chip was exactly what I wanted, but the page just kept showing everything under "הכול". I didn't know if tapping it would help, so I scrolled instead.
Many rows say "פחות מ־3 שנים" in place of a number. I didn't get whether that's bad or just new. I skipped those and only looked at rows with real numbers.
Cheaper and slightly higher than Harel, so I paused, but it says "פחות מ־5 שנים" for 5 years and I'd already settled on Harel. Didn't switch.
